# asc_security_group_attachment (Data Source)

Retrieves a specific Security Group attachment in the ASC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attachment_name` (String) The name of the attachment resource.
- `security_group_name` (String) The name of the Security Group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the security group attachment.
